beats.label: Meet BRP
beats.text: Stanford's **AI** scanned **373** hormone precursors and found **BRP,** a tiny peptide.

beats.label: Side by side
beats.text: In nerve cells, GLP-1 **tripled** activity. BRP boosted it **tenfold.**

beats.label: In animals
beats.text: One shot cut eating by up to **50%** for an hour in **mice** and **minipigs.**

beats.label: Obese mice, 14 days
beats.text: Treated mice lost about **3 grams.** Untreated mice gained about **3.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: "Natural" means your body makes it. It's still an **injection,** tested only in **animals,** by its **patent** holders.
Follow and we'll check it again if it reaches **human** trials.
